old_row.relationship: Jerusalem's wall and God's favorable action
old_row.rationale: The psalm asks God to do good to Zion and build Jerusalem's walls. Nehemiah calls for rebuilding Jerusalem's wall and reports God's good hand upon him. The particular city, wall-building and favorable divine action correspond, without assigning the psalm's request to Nehemiah's historical occasion.

old_row.relationship: A sacrifice of righteousness
old_row.rationale: Psalm50 anticipates God's delight in a sacrifice of righteousness after the prayer for Zion and Jerusalem. Psalm4 commands offering a sacrifice of righteousness and hoping in the Lord. The specific description of acceptable sacrifice connects the passages and qualifies any reading of Psalm50 as rejecting every offering without distinction.
